reason: The legacy city is New Haven, Census GEOID 0952000. Connecticut changed its county-equivalent parent to South Central Connecticut; the alias preserves the city URL, not the historical county geography.

The legacy Archer record comes from the constable address 100 Law Enforcement Way, Archer, TX 76351. Archer County identifies that exact physical address as Archer City; the saved Census polygon contains the agency point. This is a truncated city name.
The municipality calls itself City of Sunrise Beach Village and uses Sunrise Beach in its own 124 Sunrise Drive address, matching the legacy agency address.

The legacy record links to Panorama Village Police at 98 Hiwon Drive, Panorama; the saved point falls within Census Panorama Village. The city official permit identifies the municipality as Panorama Village at adjacent 99 Hiwon Drive. The legacy name omits Village.
The municipality uses Town of Pecos City and Pecos, Texas on its official site. This is the same Reeves County city, Census GEOID 4873493, not Pecos County.

The legacy city is Hartford, Census GEOID 0937000. Connecticut changed its county-equivalent parent to Capitol; the alias preserves the city URL, not the historical county geography. The unrelated placeholder agency is not evidence.
Census treats the undivided District of Columbia as one county equivalent. The old administrative-area path adds a county suffix to that same jurisdiction; it does not identify a separate county.

Boise and Boise City identify the same municipality in Ada County. The municipal site uses City of Boise and Boise City Clerk; Census uses Boise City city. The unrelated placeholder agency is not evidence.
